name: ManageEngine Mobile Device Manager Plus
summary: Mobile Device Manager Plus is free for up to 25 devices with all features and a 30-day trial. Paid cloud plans are priced by device tier, from $645 a year for 50 devices on Standard, with extra technician seats costing more. The pricing page shows dollar signs without naming a currency.

facts.text: Remote Lock works on Android, iOS and macOS devices. The help page states that Windows is not supported.
Complete Wipe erases all data on Android, iOS, macOS, ChromeOS and Windows devices, while Corporate Wipe removes only profiles and apps installed through MDM.

Enrollment options include self-enrollment, invitations and CSV bulk upload for personal devices, and automated enrollment for corporate devices through Apple Business Manager, Android Zero Touch, Samsung Knox and Windows Autopilot.
Admins publish profiles to individual devices or groups to restrict device features and to set up corporate email, Wi-Fi and VPN access.
The FAQ says a full remote wipe works only on fully managed devices, and that devices with a work profile can only have the work profile removed.

plans.name: Free edition
plans.notes: Fully functional with all features, according to the pricing page

plans.name: Standard cloud, 50 devices
plans.notes: Cloud monthly billing is $64 for the same tier

hiddenCosts: Each plan includes one technician. Extra technician seats on cloud annual billing cost $445 a year for one and $595 for two.
The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency, so confirm the currency at checkout.
Paid tiers start at 50 devices, so a business with 26 to 49 devices pays the 50-device price.
Larger tiers up to 10,000 devices are listed on the page and are not shown in this profile.
